articles.title: Foo Cexiang sworn in as Minister of State
articles.content: The 41-year-old spent nearly 15 years as a civil servant before entering politics in the last General Election. He is currently an MP in Tanjong Pagar GRC. He has held portfolios spanning industrial planning, security policy, education planning
articles.summary:

📢 Foo Cexiang sworn in as Minister of State
